info.title: Autodesk Construction Cloud API
info.description: Autodesk Platform Services (APS) and Construction Cloud API providing access to Data Management, BIM 360 / Autodesk Construction Cloud project data, Model Derivative services, Account Administration, and Webhooks.

tags.name: Data Management
tags.description: Manage hubs, projects, folders, items, versions, and storage in BIM 360 and ACC.

tags.name: BIM 360
tags.description: Autodesk Construction Cloud and BIM 360 endpoints for issues, RFIs, submittals, locations, cost management, and forms.

tags.name: Model Derivative
tags.description: Translate designs into different formats and extract metadata from design files.

tags.name: Account Admin
tags.description: Manage BIM 360 / ACC accounts, projects, users, and companies.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Subscribe to events and receive notifications for changes in APS resources.

get.description: Returns a collection of accessible hubs for the current authenticated user.

401.description: Unauthorized. Invalid or expired access token.

403.description: Forbidden. The user does not have permission.

get.description: Returns data for a specific hub.

parameters.name: hubId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the hub.

get.description: Returns a collection of projects for a given hub.

parameters.name: hubId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the hub.

get.description: Returns details for a specific project within a hub.
Returns a collection of items and folders within a given folder.

post.description: Creates a new folder in the specified project.

get.description: Returns the folder by ID for a given project.

post.description: Creates a new item (first version of a file) in the specified project.

409.description: Conflict. An item with the same name already exists.

get.description: Returns the item by ID for a given project.
Returns versions for the given item.
Returns the version by ID for a given project.
Returns a list of buckets owned by the application.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Region where the bucket resides (US, EMEA).

post.description: Creates a new OSS bucket for storing objects.

put.description: Uploads an object to the specified bucket.

get.description: Returns a list of issues for the specified project.

post.description: Creates a new issue in the specified project.

get.description: Returns a single issue by ID.
Returns a list of available issue types and subtypes for the project.
Returns comments associated with an issue.

post.description: Adds a comment to an issue.

get.description: Returns a list of RFIs for the specified project.

post.description: Creates a new RFI in the specified project.

get.description: Returns a single RFI by ID.
Returns a list of submittal items for the specified project.
Returns location nodes for a given tree in the specified project.

parameters.name: treeId
parameters.description: The location tree ID (use 'default' for the default tree).

get.description: Returns the location trees configured for the project.
Returns a list of budget line items for the cost container.

post.description: Creates a new budget line item.

get.description: Returns a list of contracts for the cost container.
Returns a list of change orders for the cost container.
Returns a list of forms for the specified project.

post.description: Submits a translation job to convert a design file to a specified output format (SVF, SVF2, OBJ, STL, STEP, IGES, etc.).

200.description: Translation job submitted or already complete.

get.description: Returns the manifest of derivatives for a source design, including translation status and available outputs.

parameters.name: urn
parameters.description: The Base64-encoded URN of the source design.

delete.description: Deletes the manifest and all derivatives for the specified source design.

get.description: Returns a list of model views (metadata) for a source design.

parameters.name: urn
parameters.description: The Base64-encoded URN of the source design.

get.description: Returns the object tree (hierarchy) for a specific model view.

parameters.name: modelGuid
parameters.description: The GUID of the model view.

get.description: Returns properties for all objects in the specified model view.

parameters.name: objectId
parameters.description: Filter by object ID to return properties for a specific object.

get.description: Returns a thumbnail image for the specified design.
Returns a list of supported translation formats.
Returns a list of projects for the specified BIM 360 / ACC account.

post.description: Creates a new project in the BIM 360 / ACC account.

get.description: Returns details for a specific project in the account.

patch.description: Updates a project in the account.

get.description: Returns a list of users in the BIM 360 / ACC account.

post.description: Adds a user to the BIM 360 / ACC account.

get.description: Returns a list of companies in the BIM 360 / ACC account.
Returns a list of users assigned to the specified project.

post.description: Assigns a user to the specified project with a given role.

get.description: Returns a list of webhooks for the specified system and event.

post.description: Creates a new webhook subscription for the specified system and event.

get.description: Returns details for a specific webhook.
Returns all webhooks for the current application across all systems and events.

post.description: Obtains an access token using client credentials (2-legged OAuth) or authorization code (3-legged OAuth).

400.description: Bad request. Invalid grant type or missing parameters.

get.description: Returns the profile of the currently authenticated user.
Returns the top-level folders for a project. These are the root-level folders like 'Project Files' and 'Plans'.
Searches for items within a folder by name or other attributes.
Returns custom attribute definitions for issues in the project.
Returns a list of industry roles for the account.
Returns a list of business units for the account.

oauth2.description: Autodesk Platform Services OAuth 2.0 authentication supporting 2-legged (client credentials) and 3-legged (authorization code) flows.

bucketKey.description: A unique name for the bucket.

urn.description: The Base64-encoded URN of the source design.

rootFilename.description: The root filename for compressed archives.

callbackUrl.description: The URL to receive webhook notifications.

scope.description: The scope that defines the resources to monitor.

hookAttribute.description: Custom metadata to include with notifications.

filter.description: JSON filter expression to narrow event scope.
